'''Ull Murub''' was a Force-sensitive [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Sullustan/Legends|Sullustan]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] with the rank of [[Jedi Guardian/Legends|Guardian]]. During the [[Imperial Era/Legends|Imperial Era]], Murub and [[Ull Murub's master|his master]] survived the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]'s [[Great Jedi Purge/Legends|Great Jedi Purge]] while stationed on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Sullust/Legends|Sullust]]. After the fall of the Empire, Murub joined the Academy of the [[New Jedi Order]], but dropped out and returned home where he was stalked by [[Unidentified Dark Jedi (Ull Murub)|a Dark Jedi]].

==Biography==
A [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Sullustan/Legends|Sullustan]], Ull Murub was inducted into the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] and [[Jedi training/Legends|trained]] in the ways of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]]. After a time, he was selected as a [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] by [[Ull Murub's master|an elder Jedi]], and was soon stationed on the Sullustan [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of [[Sullust/Legends|Sullust]]. During the [[Imperial Era/Legends|Imperial Era]] following the end of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], Murub and his master managed to survive the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]'s destruction of the Jedi Order and the [[Great Jedi Purge/Legends|Great Jedi Purge]] while on Sullust. Decades later, Murub joined the Academy of the [[New Jedi Order]], but dropped out and returned home to figure out what he should do next. Though the still young Murub longed for adventure like deflecting [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] bolts and saving [[Princess/Legends|princess]]es, even believing that war would be exciting, he found himself more often than not performing mundane tasks, such as using his [[Force power/Legends|abilities]] to help citizens find lost [[Credit chip/Legends|cred sticks]]. While on Sullust, [[Unidentified Dark Jedi (Ull Murub)|a]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]], formerly a [[Jedi Consular]], took notice of Murub and hoped to one day encourage his thirst to be a hero, in order to pull him down the path toward the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]]. At some point, Murub deflected a series of blaster bolts while standing in a hallway.<ref name="GORW" />

==Powers and abilities==
Murub was able to [[Language/Legends|speak]] and [[Writing/Legends|read and write]] in [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Galactic Basic Standard]] and [[Sullustese/Legends|Sullustese]].<ref name="GORW" />

==Equipment==
Ull Murub wore brown [[Jedi apparel/Legends|Jedi robes]] and carried a blue-bladed [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] and a [[Comlink/Legends|comlink]].<ref name="GORW" />

==Behind the scenes==
Ull Murub was introduced in the [[2004]] [[roleplaying game]] sourcebook ''[[Geonosis and the Outer Rim Worlds]]'' published by [[Wizards of the Coast]].<ref name="GORW" /> The character's artwork for the sourcebook was drawn by [[Mark Tedin]]<ref name="TedinFile">{{WookCite|url=File:Ull_Murub.jpg?oldid=2179519|text=January 28, 2008 revision of File:Ull Murub.jpg}}</ref> under a contract with [[Lucasfilm]] and Wizards of the Coast.<ref name="Bantha68">{{WookCite|url=User_talk:Bantha68|text=User talk page for {{U|Bantha68}}}}</ref>
